title: Planner - Projects plan file
description: A project plan file, as Export writes it and Import reads it (format "project-plan", version 1). This schema says what a JSON Schema can say. Import also checks what it cannot: a day must be a real day from 1900 to 2200 (2026-02-30 and 2300-01-01 match the pattern but are refused); work's end is not before its start; every `parent` and `waitsOn` names an `id` in the file, no entry is part of itself, `parent` is a milestone, `waitsOn` is a milestone or work, and nothing waits on itself in a loop; each `id` is used once; when the plan's "Dates are needed" setting is on, a milestone needs a `start` and work a `start` and an `end`; text lengths count after trimming. Use the Check file entry in the Export and import menu for those.
$comment: The format is written out in FORMAT.md beside this file. Fields that are not listed are ignored by Import, so additionalProperties is left open.

boards.description: The plan's board, as Export writes it. Optional; at most one for now.

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real day from 1900 to 2200 (checked by Import, not by this pattern). Empty or null means no day.

columnId.description: A column id: lower case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

done.description: true: work in this column counts as done.

board.description: Needs at least one column that counts as done and one that does not, and each column id once (checked by Import, not by this schema).

id.description: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores; used once in the file. Needed only when another entry names this one.

title.description: Up to 120 characters, not only spaces.

parent.description: The id of a milestone in the file.

waitsOn.description: Ids of milestones or work in the file; at most 50.

owners.description: People's keys; leave out unless the file came from this environment.

tags.description: Tag ids from the plan's Tags setting.

column.description: Work only: the id of its column on the board. Work whose column the board does not have reads as the first done column if it is done, else the first column that does not count as done.

then.$comment: A note has no days, no waitsOn and no done: Import ignores them.
A milestone has one day, start; an end is ignored. Import needs start when the plan needs dates.
Work has a start and an end, end not before start. Import needs both when the plan needs dates; with one, it takes it for both.
